name: chunk-expansion-assembles
description: chunks expand into the triad — the opener carries the id, the continuation omits it, and the run terminal closes the stream
kill: stop synthesizing the TEXT_MESSAGE_END when a run-level event closes an open chunk lane

dotnet.intentional: GAP, not a design difference: EventStreamConverter has no case for TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK or TOOL_CALL_CHUNK, so a chunk stream falls through to the pass-through branch. Nothing is expanded into a message and none of the chunk-stream rules are enforced. Pinned here so the gap cannot widen or close unnoticed; alignment tracked separately. Here the two chunks assemble into nothing at all.
